staged rollout with SLO instrumentation, replay evidence and operator enablement.
challenger models/policies, conformance monitoring, quarterly value reviews.

blocks.x: Day to day, the operating team sees one control surface: health, throughput, cost and policy violations for the workloads Patient Priority Portal carries. Escalations arrive with the context attached — the runbook, the affected scope, the last passing evidence — instead of a raw alert and a hunch.

Hyperledger Fabric/Besu, HSM fleets, W3C VC/DID, static/formal verification tools — integrated through versioned contracts. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are maintained like products: schema changes are tested against consumer suites before release, and one contract update propagates to every human or agent consumer.
